runtime_prompt_en:
An outdoor fashion photograph of an adult woman wearing an ivory V-neck midi dress in an alpine meadow in the Alps. Jagged mountain ridges with lingering snow rise beyond green slopes beneath a clear blue sky. She stands on a level patch of short grass, both feet resting on the ground in simple flat sandals, her arms relaxed beside her torso and her hands visible. Her body turns slightly toward the valley while her face angles toward the camera with a quiet, relaxed smile. A gentle breeze lifts a few loose strands of hair and sends small ripples through the skirt, its hem shifting softly around her calves. Warm sunlight falls across her face and the V-shaped neckline, bringing out the fine weave of the fabric and a soft glow along her hair. Prioritize the airy alpine setting and the subtle movement of the dress, with natural skin texture, delicate fabric detail, and a peaceful sense of warmth in the mountain air. Frame her from head to sandals with a little grass below her feet so the drifting hem remains fully visible. Place her in the left third of the image, opening the right side toward the sunlit valley and distant ridges. Photograph at eye level with a 50mm lens and moderate depth of field, keeping her face and dress crisp while the mountain contours remain recognizable. Use the attached portrait as the face and hairstyle reference for this woman, preserving her facial proportions, eye shape and spacing, nose, lip shape, jaw contour, and long dark wavy hair, adapted naturally to the outdoor sunlight and gentle breeze.

Avoid: cartoon style, 3D render look, low resolution, excessive HDR, illustration look, over-processed retouching, fake-looking background
